note: Central catalog of fonts already documented or licensed by individual channel projects, gathered ahead of the Phase 4 central typography library per explicit user instruction. Commercial/licensed font BINARIES are intentionally not copied into this repo -- only their family names, roles, and source locations are recorded, to avoid redistributing fonts whose license terms are unverified.
